unresolved_release_review.status: Fixed official-source route selected; Windows signature validation and release review required
unresolved_release_review.detail: Eight Qt/Shiboken destinations use five unmodified official Microsoft VSIX members; two CPython DLLs retain their original CPython provenance. Every build must validate SHA-256 and Authenticode. The dynamic catalog SHA/size discrepancy remains unresolved and is not claimed as verified. Final downstream terms/notices and clean offline acceptance remain release gates.
